timing_and_memory.resource_limits: No continuous lifetime thread or child-absence proof, no isolated native peak-memory measurement and no embedded-board qualification. Supervisor concurrent usage is excluded, but pre-exec inherited memory in the child can contribute to child ru_maxrss.
timing_and_memory.rss_interpretation: ru_maxrss is a lifetime child-process high-water mark preserved across exec. The launcher uses a preexec_fn, so the child can first contain inherited Python memory. The 12496 KiB value can include that pre-exec footprint and must not be labeled pure native runtime working set. Saved evidence does not establish how much is inherited. The 2872 KiB /proc RSS/HWM and 5436 KiB VmSize values are maxima among six sampled observations, not continuous or exact native peaks.

trace.cold_reset_evidence: Five clip_start records plus one unchanged collector run_reset call per clip; no separate reset records
